name: Helvétius
major_ideas: Environmental determinism and the omnipotence of education
biography: Presented as a representative philosopher of the French Revolution who combined Lockean empiricism with an extreme environmentalist optimism, holding that all differences between individuals are due to education.

disagreements.about: Environmental determinism and the omnipotence of education
